_meta.description: Template for capturing opaque Cinema Studio 4.0 preset UUIDs and structured lighting/palette payloads extracted once from a Web Cinema Studio job.
extraction_workflow: 1. Configure camera, lens, aperture, genre, era, pacing, lighting, and palette once in https://higgsfield.ai/cinema-studio and run one reference job.
2. Inspect the completed job JSON via: higgsfield generate get <job_id> --json

3. Copy the resolved UUID fields (`camera_*_id`, `genre_id`, `era_id`, `pacing_id`) plus any verbatim `color_palette` object or custom lighting fields (`light`, `light_id`, `light_custom`) into docs/cinema-presets.json (or campaigns/<slug>/cinema-presets.json) and reference them from shotlist.json.
_meta.notes: Values below are schema-valid against `higgsfield workflow get cinematic_studio_video_4_0 --json` (CLI 1.2.3). Replace illustrative RFC-4122 UUIDs and placeholder `light_custom` (`[]`) / `color_palette` (`{}`) containers with live payloads from `higgsfield generate get <job_id> --json`. Note live CLI 1.2.3 constraints: `color_palette` is `object|null` (never a UUID string); `light` is `preset|custom|user|null`, `light_id` only accepts `"custom"`, and CEL requires non-null `light_custom` (`array`) whenever `light` or `light_id` is `"custom"` (while forbidding `light_custom` for `preset`/`user`, which currently cannot take a non-`custom` `light_id` in CLI). Omit lighting/palette fields (as in `editorial_golden_hour`) to control light and color in prose.

commercial_hero_macro.label: Commercial Hero Macro — Crisp Studio Key (with custom lighting & palette objects)
commercial_hero_macro.visual_notes: Clean commercial macro look with shallow depth of field, controlled specular key, and neutral highlights. Replace `light_custom` (`[]`) and `color_palette` (`{}`) with the verbatim JSON array/object from `higgsfield generate get <job_id> --json`.

editorial_golden_hour.label: Editorial Lifestyle — Warm Natural Backlight (optics UUIDs only; lighting/palette in prose)
editorial_golden_hour.visual_notes: Handheld editorial cadence with warm late-afternoon rim light and filmic shadow roll-off; lighting and palette are intentionally omitted so they are driven cleanly in prompt prose.
